description: [Wicked Sanity] Verify one claim before acting on it. Verdicts: supported | contradicted | unsupported | insufficient_evidence (see `data`). confidence_score is raw consistency (a "contradicted" verdict scores near 0). Policy: act on supported; treat unsupported/insufficient_evidence as unverified; reject contradicted. x402 or SANITY_API_KEY; 429 means a rate limit — see retry_after.

claim.description: The single statement to verify (max 5,000 chars).

context.description: Source text the claim(s) must be faithful to. Required for mode "grounded".

mode.description: "grounded" (default; check against context) or "open" (check against live web evidence — consistency with the web, not objective truth).

name: sanity_check
